title: Isolate evaluation-cut and source-accounting order with a deterministic diagnostic fixture
outcome: A bounded isolated fixture distinguishes evaluation fingerprint sampling from scoped source accounting and ACK order, without changing production admission or claiming to reconstruct missing historical evidence.
acceptance: The fixture drives the existing acceptance preparation and source-observation/accounting paths under deterministic scheduling and records cut, sampling, scope/claim/root/grant, pending-close/owner, request and validated-ACK transitions with immutable attempt-local identities and full content revisions.

Paired schedules distinguish accounting before the cut from accounting after the cut while holding bytes constant; controls cover a different scope on the same root, a delayed or refused closing ACK, and an actual post-cut change/revert. Missing evidence is explicit and no result claims to prove the historical incident's cause.

A bounded report states which mechanisms were reproduced, which hypotheses remain untested, exact source and tool inputs, and the resulting design question. No live-store/database access, durable schema change, production admission change, interval-only workaround, or relaxed positional refusal is introduced.
